caption: The drawing features three distinct objects, all rendered in dark tones with metallic textures. At the top is a long, narrow, horizontally-aligned metal hinge bar with rounded ends and a flat, perpendicular mounting section on the right. In the middle section, there is a large, old-fashioned iron key with a rounded, oval-shaped bow (handle), decorative grooves near the bow, and a notched bit at the opposite end. At the bottom, there is a rectangular black metal lock box with visible screws at the corners, a keyhole in the center, and a round, yellowish metallic pull handle affixed to the front face on the right side. The objects are arranged vertically against a plain, light beige background, with each object spaced apart from the others.
title: Lock, Key, Hinge
